expectations.text: Matches workspaces by both UUID/ID and human-friendly name
expectations.evidence: resolve.rs line 39-41: `w.id == query || w.name.to_ascii_lowercase() == q_lower` — checks both ID (exact) and name (case-insensitive). Tests confirm: resolve_by_id and resolve_by_name_case_insensitive.
resolve.rs line 37: `let q_lower = query.to_ascii_lowercase()` then compared with `w.name.to_ascii_lowercase()`. Test resolve_by_name_case_insensitive passes 'acme corp' to match 'Acme Corp'.

expectations.text: Auto-picks sole workspace with a log message to stderr
expectations.evidence: resolve.rs lines 53-57: when workspaces.len()==1, returns the workspace and calls `eprintln!("auto: using workspace {:?} ({})", ws.name, ws.id)`.

expectations.text: On ambiguity, shows copy-pasteable --workspace <value> flags in error
expectations.evidence: output.rs format_resolve_error for AmbiguousWorkspace: `msg.push_str(&format!("  --workspace {:?}  # {}{}", ws.name, ws.id, label))` — shows copy-pasteable --workspace flags for each candidate.

expectations.text: Error mentions config file as an alternative to flags
expectations.evidence: output.rs line 111: `msg.push_str("or set defaults.workspace in ~/.config/pmtool/config.toml")` — mentions config file as alternative.

expectations.text: Function is async (requires API call to fetch workspaces)
expectations.evidence: resolve.rs: `pub async fn resolve_workspace(client: &Client, hint: Option<&str>) -> Result<Workspace, ResolveError>` — async function that calls `client.list_workspaces().await`.
